column1: # test/vectors/tlog.json, generated from upstream golang.org/x/mod, run
# through each port's wrappers -- ts/src/tlog.ts over @aontu/mod, and
# go/tlog.go over the upstream library itself.
# src names a group of the vector file, a nested group spelled with a
# dot (note.signed). Every case in the group must answer what its vector
# says, or the row fails naming the case. expect is the group's counts:
# `cases`, and for a group whose cases accept or refuse, `accepted` and
# `refused`. The refusals are the point: most proofs in the file must
# The tilePath group is not here. Go wraps upstream's sumdb tile path
# encoding and @aontu/mod keeps that encoding off its surface, so
